# AI Automation Kings (AIAK)

> Websites and AI SEO for local service businesses. If a business has no website, I build one. If it has one, I get it found on Google and in AI answers. Every call gets answered, and every job ends with a review request.

Founded by Nathan Mamo. Based in Houston, Texas. One person, two sides of the work, shown on the site as two tabs.

## Nate the Dev

For a business with no website, or one that is holding it back.

- **The website.** A fast site with one job: get someone to call. Live in days, not months. Built from the first line so Google and AI answer tools can read it properly. Every build gets a second review before it goes live. It works the way the business works rather than bending the business to a template.
- **The phone.** Every inbound call gets answered, the usual questions get handled, and the job goes on the calendar, nights and weekends included.
- **The account.** Calls, texts, reviews, and bookings in one place the owner can open on a phone, billed monthly.

## Recent builds

Live client sites, among many more.

- [Father & Son's Mobile Detailing](https://www.fathersonsmobiledetailinghouston.com/): Mobile detailing and ceramic coating, Richmond, TX.
- [HealthCo Center](https://www.healthcopharmacy.com/): Pharmacy, infusion, and wellness, Houston, TX.
- [Rapunzel Salon & Barbershop](https://rapunzel-salon-ga.com/): Salon and barbershop, Warner Robins, GA.

## Nate the Marketer

For a business that already has a website.

- **AI SEO.** No rebuild for the sake of one. The existing site gets checked for what Google and AI cannot read or trust, that gets fixed, then every service, service area, and common customer question becomes a page that answers it. Listings are made to agree on name, address, phone, and hours, and the Google profile is kept current. A monthly report in plain English.
- **Reviews.** Every finished job ends with a review request. Same ask to every customer, no filtering by how happy they seem, and no incentives. Fresh reviews are part of what keeps a business getting found.

## Who this is for

Local service businesses that do the work in one city or metro, where one more job a week is worth real money, where customers find them by searching rather than only by referral, and that are owner operated or close to it. Mobile detailing, plumbing and HVAC, roofing, lawn and landscaping, cleaning, and similar trades.

## What is not offered

B2B lead generation, cold email as a service, social media management, paid ads management, and work for businesses outside local services.

## Claims and limits

No ranking position or placement in an AI answer is ever guaranteed, because nobody controls what Google or an AI tool says. What is controlled is whether the business is findable, readable, consistent, current, and backed by a live review profile. Reviews are never gated, filtered, or incentivized. Pricing is scoped on a call and is not published anywhere.

- [Nate the Marketer](https://aiautomationkings.com/marketer): AI SEO for an existing site, what gets done every month, reviews, and straight answers on what can and cannot be promised.
